reason: NONE. What I noticed first was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code, which is a nice touch, but there is no NSF or USP seal and no reviews, and I stick with Thorne or Pure Encapsulations for something I take every night. The Complex has citrate in it, which upsets my stomach, and the plain bisglycinate is $1 a day for a brand I have never heard of.
objection: It is a brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I only trust a third-party seal I can look up, not a QR code the company made itself.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, or a few hundred honest verified reviews saying the bisglycinate is gentle on the stomach, ideally at a lower price for a first try.
